facts.claim: Disney Fantasy (Disney Cruise Line): Entered service 2012; 129,750 GT; 2500 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Dream class.
Disney Fantasy is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
She is the fourth ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the second vessel of the Dream class, following Disney Dream (2011).

catalogSpecs.description: Dream-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2012; 129,750 GT; approx. 2,500 guests at double occupancy.
